content:
sam: Quick heads-up: planning a quiet night-drop to publish 1.7.0-rc.0 for py/ts and mark the legacy sync client deprecated. Rolling in ~15m unless objections.
rita: fine by me. what's the dist-tag so CI can pin?
own: propose `rc-integration-2026-03-21b` so we don't clash with earlier tags.
chi: I'll update CHANGELOG and add `deprecated` field to the sync package package.json. Also will add the migration link.
sam: publish plan: 1) build wheels -> testpypi 2) npm pack + publish with `--tag rc-integration-2026-03-21b` 3) pin prow e2e to RC 4) run smoke + perf. Rollback on any 403, signer-mismatch, or >0.7% 5xx in first 5m.
deploy-bot: [174777-174778] publish-job started: py(jb_17477) / npm(nb_17477) :rocket:
rita: preflight checklist done: changelog, deprecated field, checksum signed, prow pin for e2e.
deploy-bot: [174778-174779] py -> testpypi SUCCESS (jb_17477). sha256: aa11bb...
own: starting npm publish now.
deploy-bot: [174779-174780] npm publish (nb_17477) FAILED: integrity mismatch writing tarball. log: `EINTEGRITY: unexpected hash for package`
chi: looks like nondeterministic pack ordering resurfaced. sam, can we pin NODE for `npm pack` in CI? Samir fixed this before by locking to 18.
sam: good catch. repacking with NODE=18 locally and adding a `pack-check` job. re-triggering publish.
deploy-bot: [174780-174781] npm publish RESTARTED -> SUCCESS. dist-tag set -> rc-integration-2026-03-21b
sam: kicking off smoke + perf harness. watching metrics.
deploy-bot: [174781-174782] smoke-suite started (is_17477)
rita: metrics check: first 3m stable, 0.06% 5xx, median latency +14ms. acceptable.
own: marketing wants a short technical blurb for comms. I'll draft: "1.7.0-rc.0 (dev preview) available via dist-tag `rc-integration-2026-03-21b`. Legacy sync client `@redwood/sdk-sync` deprecated; migrate: https://redwood.ai/migrate-sync. Removal in ~90 days"
chi: please also add the `deprecated` field to npm package metadata so registry shows the deprecation notice.
sam: done. Also adding an automated cleanup job to remove ephemeral dist-tags after 24h unless release manager extends.
deploy-bot: [174782-1747779900] smoke-suite COMPLETE: PASS (is_17477). No signer/auth issues.
sam: closing out: RC published with dist-tag rc-integration-2026-03-21b, initial pack integrity fail fixed by node pin, smoke/pass. Follow-ups: add pack checksum assertion, ensure dist-tag TTL, and file a ticket to remove deprecated package page after 90 days. Thanks all! :white_check_mark:
